system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

You can empower your Elemental Jutsu to a much higher degree, breaking through defenses. When you cast a Jutsu with a nature release keyword, you may spend 1 Superiority Die. Select one affected hostile creature, if they cast a jutsu as a reaction, to gain a bonus to their saving throw or AC, they instead treat it as a penalty.
